API ReferenceZIdentity APIAPI ClientsApiclient Ops Remove
Apiclient Ops Remove
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/api-clients/:id

Removes an existing API client from the system. After deletion, the API client cannot be recovered.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the API client to be deleted.

Responses
​
204
401

The API client was successfully deleted.

No content is returned in the response, but headers may be useful for validation purposes.
